span.normalized: Our principal business objective is to enter into commercial license agreements that enable our customers to manufacture and sell MST-enabled products, generating license revenues and ongoing royalties. We also license our MSTcad® software to customers, enabling them to simulate the effects of MST on their products using Synopsys, Inc.’s technology computer-aided design, or TCAD, software. In addition, we offer fee-based integration engineering services to customers evaluate the effects of MST as integrated into their manufacturing flow.
span.raw:
Our principal business objective
is to enter into commercial license agreements that enable our customers to manufacture and sell MST-enabled products, generating license
revenues and ongoing royalties. We also license our MSTcad<sup>®</sup> software to customers, enabling them to simulate the effects
of MST on their products using Synopsys, Inc.’s technology computer-aided design, or TCAD, software. In addition, we offer fee-based
integration engineering services to customers evaluate the effects of MST as integrated into their manufacturing flow.
